snp2.13:1.1: Sammāparibbājaniyasutta. "Pucchāmi muniṃ pahūtapaññaṃ tiṇṇam pāragataṃ parinibbutaṃ ṭhitattaṃ: nikkhamma gharā panujja kāme kathaṃ bhikkhu sammā so loke paribbajeyya". || ||
snp2.13:2.1: "Yassa maṅgalā samūhatā ti Bhagavā uppādā supinā ca lakkhaṇā ca, sa maṅgaladosavippahīno bhikkhu sammā so loke paribbajeyya. || ||
snp2.13:3.1: Rāgaṃ vinayetha nānusesu dibbesu kāmesu cāpi {bhikkhu}, atikkamma bhavaṃ samecca dhammaṃ sammā so loke paribbajeyya. || ||
snp2.13:4.1: Vipiṭṭhikatvā pesuṇāni kodhaṃ kadariyam jaheyya bhikkhu, anurodhavirodhavippahīno sammā so --pe--. || || Hitvāna
snp2.13:5.1: pivañ ca appiyañ ca anupādāya anissito kuhiñci saṃyojaniyehi vippamutto sammā so . . . || || Na so upadhīsu sāram
snp2.13:6.1: eti, ādānesu vineyya chandarāgaṃ so anissito anaññaneyyo, sammā so . . . || || Vacasā manasā ca kammanā
snp2.13:7.1: ca aviruddho sammā viditvā dhamman nibbānapadābhipatthayāno sammā so . . . || || Yo ‘vandati
snp2.13:8.1: man' ti na uṇṇameyya akkuṭṭho pi na sandhiyetha bhikkhu laddhā parabhojanaṃ na majje, sammā so . . . || || Lobhañ ca bhavañ
snp2.13:9.1: ca vippahāya virato chedanabandhanāto bhikkhu so tiṇṇakathaṃkatho visallo, sammā so . . . || || Sāruppam attano viditvā
snp2.13:10.1: na ca bhikkhu hiṃseyya kañci loke, yathātathiyaṃ viditvā dhammaṃ sammā so . . . || || Yassānusayā
snp2.13:11.1: na santi keci, mūlā akusalā samūhatāse, so nirāsayo anāsasāno, sammā so . . . || || Āsavakhīṇo pahīnamāno
snp2.13:12.1: sabbaṃ rāgapathaṃ upātivatto danto parinibbuto ṭhitatto sammā so . . . || || Saddho sutavā niyāmadassī
snp2.13:13.1: vaggagatesu na vaggasāri dhīro lobhaṃ dosaṃ vineyya paṭighaṃ sammā so . . . || || Saṃsuddhajino vivattacchaddo
snp2.13:14.1: dhammesu vasī pāragū anejo saṃkhāranirodhañāṇakusalo sammā so . . . || || Atītesu anāgatesu
snp2.13:15.1: cāpi kappātīto aticca suddhipañño sabbāyatanehi vippamutto sammā so . . . || || Aññāya padaṃ
snp2.13:16.1: samecca dhammaṃ vivaṭaṃ disvāna pahānam āsavānaṃ sabbūpadhīnaṃ parikkhayā sammā so loke paribbajeyya". || ||
snp2.13:17.1: "Addhā hi Bhagavā tath' eva etaṃ: yo so evaṃvihāri danto bhikkhu| sabbasaṃyojaniye ca vītivatto, sammā so loke paribbajeyyā" ti || || SAMMĀPARIBBĀJANIYASUTTAṂ NIṬṬHITAṂ.
